feature: Markdown Preview plugin with plugin ID `markdown-preview`, engine `explorer-action`, and variant `default`
Single-file read-only overflow action in the main AutoJs6 Explorer through `org.autojs.plugin.EXPLORER_ACTION`
Activity execution through `org.autojs.plugin.EXPLORER_ACTION_EXECUTE` with temporary read access to file and parent directory content URIs
Markdown rendering with automatic links, tables, strikethrough, heading anchors, task lists, and in-document images
GitHub Auto, GitHub Light, GitHub Dark, Paper, Sepia, and custom CSS themes with refresh and fullscreen controls
Hardened WebView policy with allowlist sanitization, CSP, guarded URI navigation, disabled JavaScript and storage, and bounded inputs

Localized plugin metadata, interface text, usage instructions, README files, and changelogs in Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
